issues.legal_issue: A later eviction suit based on non-use during a different period is not required to be stayed when it can succeed even if the earlier suit fails.
material_facts: The same parties had two earlier eviction suits pending, including one based on non-use, and the court hearing those suits could grant the relief sought in the later suit.
The later eviction suit alleged non-use during the six months immediately before it was filed, whereas the earlier non-use suit concerned a different period.
The plaintiffs could fail to prove non-use during the period relevant to the earlier suits yet prove non-use during the period relevant to the later suit.
issues.conclusion: Section 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure did not apply because the entire subject matter in the later suit was not directly and substantially in issue in the earlier suits; the stay order was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Section 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure prohibits trial of a subsequent suit only when its matter in issue is directly and substantially in issue in a previously instituted suit between the same parties and the earlier court is competent to grant the relief claimed. Its purpose is to prevent parallel trials and conflicting findings. The test is whether the decision in the earlier suit would operate as res judicata in the later suit; the whole subject matter, not merely some common questions or a similar ground of eviction, must be identical. The Court relied on National Institute of Mental Health & Neuro Sciences v. C. Parameshwara (2005) 2 SCC 256 and Dunlop India Limited v. A.A. Rahna (2011) 5 SCC 778.

rule.if: later_suit_is_a_civil_eviction_suit and earlier_suit_is_pending_between_same_parties and earlier_court_can_grant_later_relief and nonuse_claims_concern_different_periods and later_claim_can_succeed_if_earlier_claim_fails

predicates.later_suit_is_a_civil_eviction_suit: The plaintiff brought a later civil suit seeking eviction on a ground of non-use.
predicates.earlier_suit_is_pending_between_same_par: An earlier suit between the same parties was pending when the later suit was brought.
predicates.earlier_court_can_grant_later_relief: The court hearing the earlier suit had jurisdiction to grant the relief sought in the later suit.
predicates.nonuse_claims_concern_different_periods: The earlier and later non-use claims concerned different periods of alleged non-use.
predicates.later_claim_can_succeed_if_earlier_claim: The plaintiff could establish the later non-use claim and obtain relief even if the earlier non-use claim failed.

issues.definition: When a later civil eviction suit between parties is brought while a competent court has an earlier suit pending, but the non-use claims concern different periods and the later claim can succeed even if the earlier claim fails, the later suit must not be stayed for parallel trial.
